title: Stable currency totals
instruction: Some carts drift by a cent. Fix Cart.totals so USD-style two-decimal accounting is consistent: round each unit price to the nearest cent (half cents round up), then multiply by quantity and add in cents; tax is rounded once on the subtotal and total is subtotal plus tax. Prices may contain fractional cents. Preserve the public API, validation, and ordinary cart results. Add a regression test.
